title: Due-Date Change Allowances by Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier
content:
Each tier of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract carries its own allowance for moving the monthly due date: how many changes the contract may have over its life, how many installments must already be satisfied, how far the first installment on the new due day may move, the range of permitted due days and the interval between changes.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Due-date changes over the life of the contract (maximum) | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Installments satisfied before a change (minimum) | 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 1 |
| Calendar days the first installment on the new due day may fall after the current next due date (maximum) | 15 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 25 | 25 |
| Earliest permitted due day of the month | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Latest permitted due day of the month | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 |
| Calendar months between two due-date changes (minimum) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

## Notes

- Due days run from the 1st to the 28th of the month on every tier.
- Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 1+ allows 3 changes over the life of the contract after 1 satisfied installment; Tier 5 and Tier 4 allow 1 change after 6.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a Tier 3 contract the first installment on a new due day may fall up to 20 calendar days after the current next due date.
